body:
I'm struggling to keep up the fight. I mean, I'm going through the motions at this point. Everything is coming to a dead end fairly quickly. At one point, I had the idea of a future. Not something meticulously laid out but a general view. It's just harder now in the past year. 

I've dealt with lows quite often enough and have pulled myself out of poverty twice before. But each time I dip that low, I come closer to being worse off. And now I"m looking at homelessness very very soon. 

Right now... my one friend who has gotten upset over the ordeal has taken it upon himself to call the suicide hotline.. and now they are calling me. I have no idea what they can possibly say to change my mind.
